scope: B08 fixed exact ten; static XML/source evidence, not browser acceptance

children.text:
;; the `histogram` primitive can't make a multi-colored histogram,
;; so instead we plot each bar individually
foreach [ 3 4 5 6 ] [ v ->
  set-current-plot-pen (word v)
  plot-pen-reset
  plotxy v item (v - 3) bacteria-counts-region-a
]
if (plot-y-max - floor plot-y-max) != 0 [
  set-plot-y-range 0 floor plot-y-max + 1
]

;; the `histogram` primitive can't make a multi-colored histogram,
;; so instead we plot each bar individually
foreach [ 3 4 5 6 ] [ v ->
  set-current-plot-pen (word v)
  plot-pen-reset
  plotxy v item (v - 3) bacteria-counts-region-b
]
if (plot-y-max - floor plot-y-max) != 0 [
  set-plot-y-range 0 floor plot-y-max + 1
]

foreach [ 3 4 5 6 ] [ v ->
  set-current-plot-pen (word v)
  plotxy ticks item (v - 3) bacteria-counts-region-b
]

foreach [ 3 4 5 6 ] [ v ->
  set-current-plot-pen (word v)
  plotxy ticks item (v - 3) bacteria-counts-region-a
]

set-plot-x-range 1 max-eye-size
set-plot-y-range 0 count fish
set-histogram-num-bars 10
